_note: The KiwiSpec service (docs/kiwispec.md), on the control computer:
Addresses are 127.0.0.1 placeholders; ports are the legacy servers' (spectrograph.ini SERVER_PORT, CAMERA_PORT).
allow_hardware false: see docs/kiwispec.md before turning it on.
stage_positions (mm): spectrograph_server.ini [I2POSITIONS] (in 11, flat 68, out 102), which the stage server
moves to; the client's spectrograph.ini lists 145/88/55, the server file's previous values (stale).
heater_setpoint, heater_tolerance: spectrograph.ini I2SETTEMP, I2TEMPTOL. ccd_format, readout_mode:
spectrograph.ini [SI_SETTINGS]. telescopes: all four can feed the fiber; T3 and T4 are down (Aqawan 2).
name: kiwispec
